_note: Hand-written scoring stand-ins for trade ideas published before trades carried their own 'legs' (before 2026-11-10). Keyed by lower-cased trade name. Options/vol trades are scored as the underlying direction; steepeners as long IEF / short TLT; target_pct only where the prose states a % move on the position (low end of a range). Ideas scored from this file are flagged 'reconstructed'.
